function S(v,d){d=d||0;var t=typeof v;if(t==='string')return JSON.stringify(v);if(t==='symbol')return String(v);if(t==='function')return 'fn';if(v===null||t!=='object')return Object.is(v,-0)?'-0':String(v);if(d>3)return '...';if(Array.isArray(v)){var r=[];for(var i=0;i<v.length&&i<20;i++)r.push(i in v?S(v[i],d+1):'<hole>');return '['+r.join(',')+(v.length>20?',..'+v.length:'')+']'}return '{'+Reflect.ownKeys(v).map(function(x){return String(x)+':'+S(v[x],d+1)}).join(',')+'}'}
function D(o,k){var d=Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(o,k);return d===undefined?'undefined':S(d)}
